problem: A particle $P$ moves along the $x$-axis and its velocity at time $t$ is given by $v(t)=4\sqrt[3]{t}-1.$ What is the total displacement of the particle between $t=1$ and $t=8?$

feedback.worked_solution:
We find the total displacement by calculating the definite integral of the velocity.

Let $d$ be the total displacement between $t=1$ and $t=2.$ Then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}d & ={\int }_{1}^{2}(6t+2)\,\text{dt} \\  & =(3{t}^{2}+2t){|}_{1}^{2} \\  & =[3(2)^{2}+2(2)]-[3(1)^{2}+2(1)] \\  & =[12+4]-[3+2] \\  & =11.\end{aligned}
$$
